svg.title: LandDroid autopilot — repository flyby
svg.desc: Autoplaying starmap. A ship on autopilot orbits a star and visits each repository, shown as a planet colored by language and sized by star count, planting a flag on arrival. Ported from the AOSP LandDroid easter egg (android-17_0_0_r1, packages/EasterEgg, com.android.egg.landroid); no script, pure SVG/SMIL.
